certificate: Original conservative nominal-slot residual; G requires exactly one residual slot per residual row. G_prime requires every cyclic SCC to have exactly one internal marked nominal slot per node. Keep duplicate physical-parent slots distinct in certificates.
control: Permanent zero pins, all vertices eligible, synchronous update, convergence from every compatible physical initial state.

exact_validation.boundaries: ConstantZERO; lambda0 with positive AND mass; deterministic allAND haslambda0,rho1 outside strict contraction, nonzero all-one fixedpoint, and positive controlcost despite zero marked-singletoncycles.
exact_validation.enumeration: All distinct source-label matching sequences, equiprobable, and all positive-probability local corner assignments with exact rational weights.
exact_validation.families: All three declared laws atn2 plus homogeneous degree2 mixtures ZERO/AND (weights40/60), constantZERO, and constantAND.
identities: Nominal support probabilities on active-slot masks0,1,2,3 are0,q1,q2,Pr(anycorner1).
exact_validation.main_gate: Independent exact small-network checks must pass before simulation begins.
exact_validation.physical_checks: Every tiny realized network has independently checked residual certificates, exact optimum, and feasible pins.

matching: Uniform labeled-output-stub matching into two ordered input slots; source-label permutations have equal labeled-stub multiplicity. Self-loops and repeated parents are retained.
outputs: One compressed CSV and JSON detail record per draw, including full regenerated-network hash, residual nominal rows and SCC records, plus9cell CSV/JSON summaries.
parameter_definition: lambda=sum_type fraction*degree*(q1+q2)/2; rho=sum_type fraction*degree*Pr(B1 OR B2 OR B12)/2; psi(u)=lambda*u*(1-u)+rho*u*u; contraction coefficient=max(lambda,rho). All declared mean degrees are exactly2.
rng_call_sequence: Build deterministic type blocks in declared type order, exact integer counts n*fraction, vertex labels increasing within blocks.
Build output source-label multiset with the declared degrees; call rng.permutation(output_sources), reshape row-major to (n,2).
For each type block in declared order call rng.choice(8,size=type_count,p=np.asarray(weights,dtype=float64)/probability_denominator); expand code bit0/bit1/bit2 to [B1,B2,B12].
scope: Independent 18,000-network joint-rule sample with fixed model probabilities and separate finite-size summaries.
solver: Unchanged SCC SCC solver; isolated component dynamics identify repeated physical slots, hold all exterior errors at zero, enumerate candidate pinsets directly without monotonicity assumptions.

statistics.G_and_G_prime: Exact observed failure counts and pointwise two-sided95% Clopper-Pearson intervals.
statistics.P0: Definite zero count=uppercost0; possible zero count=lowercost0. Pointwise conservative95% Clopper-Pearson envelope from lower endpoint count to upper endpoint count.
statistics.fixed_benchmark: mu=-log(1-lambda), Poisson meanmu, rawsecondmomentmu+mu², P0=1-lambda. No fittedparameters, additional hypothesis tests, or convergence-rate inference.
statistics.mean_and_raw_second_moment: Complete-sample lower/upper endpoint averages; endpoint SE from unbiased sample variances divided byN; 95% pointwise normal envelope [max(0,lower_mean-z*SE_lower),upper_mean+z*SE_upper]. Endpoint SEs are attached to endpoint variables, not a point estimate of an unresolved cost.

study: JointRules focused validation of general joint two-input planted rule laws
unresolved: Retain all cost intervals and feasible upper witnesses. No discarding or imputation. No pre-existing-cost intersection applies to this new sample.
work_unit: One local-row evaluation constructing component successors or one controlled successor-edge traversal; budget per complex SCC, no wall-time cutoff.
